admission.justification: Direct and alias/literal controls protect a derived population so a new support module cannot repeat the known raw-path overwrite unnoticed in the covered syntactic classes.

applicability: The recursive static settings-path scan of non-test Python support under mcp/tests, excluding the guard, and all Python support under mcp/test_support.
conditions: The scan recognizes raw and import-aliased resolver calls, attribute resolver names, and literal marker rebuilds through division/join/joinpath.
Synthetic negative-control modules are parsed, never executed.
exclusions: Arbitrary dynamic Python data-flow and every possible settings path spelling.
Test files under mcp/tests, which retain conftest isolation.

evidence: notes/reports/reviewer/5e0b3a10-7a35-4c5e-9f11-135000000002/r4/candidate-attempt3.json; notes/reports/reviewer/5e0b3a10-7a35-4c5e-9f11-135000000002/r4/guard-tests-r4.log; retained R1/R2 route and actual probe evidence under explicit author rulings

statement: The automatic support scanner recursively includes non-test modules and rejects raw/import-aliased resolver calls and literal settings marker rebuilds while guarded calls pass.
